description: Get e/acc's edited daily overview, either the latest issue or a real YYYY-MM-DD date. Use this when the user asks for a daily report rather than a raw chronological list.

date.description: Optional real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest daily report.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

name: eacc_get_daily
